recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reapply the DSTU1 rename unless a future work group decision narrows Procedure.subject back to Patient-only.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Procedure request to rename Procedure.subject to Procedure.patient because the element was only allowed to reference Patient.
initial_application: Git commit 34a07126efd7f1aba8087adf8facefcd680e5dcb initially changed the Procedure spreadsheet and examples from Procedure.subject to Procedure.patient and tagged the row with [#3709]. FHIR-7633 later recorded that Procedure.patient was renamed back to Procedure.subject and Group was added for consistency, with implementation history in 27f73740e4afc943ade51df795872e6e5c3865ee.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Procedure.source uses Procedure.subject with patient as an alias and targets Patient, Group, Device, Practitioner, Organization, and Location; Procedure narrative says procedures can be performed on non-patient subjects. FHIR-26859 intentionally broadened Procedure.subject beyond Patient/Group, and the patient search parameter remains a patient-only expression over Procedure.subject.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because renaming the current multi-target subject element to patient would contradict later Patient Care decisions and current non-patient Procedure scope.
